## Checklist

- [ ] Facts in `report/` have a source (link, book + page, or document in `media/`)
- [ ] My memory is first-hand, or clearly labelled as retold
- [ ] I own the media I'm uploading, or have permission to share it, and I've filled in its licence
- [ ] People shown or named who are alive have consented (or the information is already public)
- [ ] Nothing here is AI-generated imagery or an invented quote
- [ ] I agree to license my text under CC BY-SA 4.0
